subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Combinatorial Explosion
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Combinatorial Explosion.

hook.text: 5 fields with 5 values each: 3,125 combinations. Add one more field: 15,625. Exhaustive testing is impossible.

buildup.text: Combinatorial explosion happens when the number of test combinations grows exponentially with each new variable.

discovery.text: No team has time to test every combination. The goal is covering the most risky ones efficiently.

twist.text: Skipping combinations isn't laziness—it's strategy. The trick is knowing which combinations carry the most risk.

climax.text: Techniques like pairwise, risk-based selection, and boundary focus tame the explosion into manageable sets.

punchline.text: You can't test everything. Test the right things.

quiz.question: What causes combinatorial explosion in testing?
options: Exponential growth of combinations with each new variable
